algorithm: 1 Verify event, identity, clock, branch, actor epistemic readset and world role; reject invalid/stale source.

2 Construct finite task-specific candidate actions from permissible action grammar, actor skills, objectively possible world methods and actor-visible event features; do not input the desired response.
3 Validate feasibility/exposure; tag unseen causes as unavailable for B-specific actor appraisal. Include genuine action/no-action/refusal choices only as candidates.
4 Recruit *multiple* source-backed prior projects/expectations/practice/relations, including contradictory ones, without scalar averaging or a global winner.
5 Build directed conditional reason/support/obstruction graph with exact event/owner refs and evidence-sensitive conditional preference comparisons.
6 Prune dominated actions ONLY with explicit context-specific reason priority supported by actor history and an accepted test-only evaluator. Preserve cycles/contradictions and unknowns.

7 If one uniquely undefeated option with an actual priority basis remains, select/emit model-generated attempted-action request; if several, return OPEN_CHOICE_SET pending exact separate policy rather than choosing by prose flair.
8 Independently enact or reject actor action in world/action performer. Record outcome separately from selection; current CAN008 response and CAN011 target remain independent.

9 Capture replay receipts for all readsets, candidates, reason edges, removed options, selection policy and action outcome; no private B motive, hidden actor user-model leak or unwanted lasting effect.

algorithm: 1 Receive actual acted/nonacted opportunities from world/actor owner; do not let LLM-supplied outcome label stand as performed action.
2 If valid actor-accessible feedback exists, create/refer to an episodic case in the existing memory/event owner; if feedback missing, leave learned outcome unknown.
3 At later occasions retrieve only task/goal/operation/constraint-comparable episodes, keeping failed/contrary cases and dissimilarity limitations; forbid raw text similarity as scientific transfer.
4 Produce guarded candidate method from prior actually enacted primitives and feedback; validate operation legality/required capabilities and actual physical goal effects via separate world engine.

5 Differentiate previous competence, improved tool availability, role selection, B assistance and genuine newly executable method through a sourced beforestate and later changed-context independent transfer.
6 If no qualified transfer or beforestate: case history may exist, but CAN011 T returns NO_CHANGE or proposed procedural hypothesis; no practice object.

7 If such evidence exists: TEST_ONLY propose narrow method/context target with own rule/permission dependency; a separate competent CAN011 T evaluator must decide native CREATE/revision, not the LLM or this court.
8 Later use may recruit the practice only within context guard; contrary projects may still defeat enactment, action can fail under changed world constraints and other practices may contradict it.
